recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source change is needed for FHIR-34307; future work should happen only if FHIR-I wants a new substantive rule for logical model element definitions or invariant compatibility beyond the already-published decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-34307 was a Published FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to relax sdf-3 because forcing formal definitions on every element does not make sense for some logical models, and it also requested the versions page to clarify that normative invariant changes are prohibited only when they break forward compatibility.
initial_application: The issue was applied by cb57c390ab490af5018e01f60f27c5f395e282ca, which changed sdf-3 on StructureDefinition.snapshot so the formal-definition/cardinality rule is skipped when %resource.kind = 'logical', and changed source/versions.html to frame invariant changes around forward compatibility. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-34307 existed on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes StructureDefinition as a resource, so source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml is in current build scope. A later FHIR-36755 commit superseded the exact versions-page wording with a more specific compatible formulation that bars changes that could invalidate previous instances while allowing warning/best-practice and certain error invariants; FHIR-36755 is already represented on the combined branch. The August 2022 FHIR-I minutes and Zulip thread show the application review focused on whether normative invariants were checked and on unreliable xpath constraints; FHIR-37871 later addressed the xpath concern and is also already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: This reconciliation made no source changes. Current source already implements the seed decision: sdf-3 has the logical-model exception in its FHIRPath expression and human text, and the versions page now contains later-approved compatibility wording that preserves the seed's forward-compatibility intent.

related_jiras.note: Superseded the exact versions-page wording with the current warning/error invariant compatibility text and already has an issue-reconcile commit on the combined branch.
Arose from the same application review and removed the unreliable xpath constraint concern; it already has an issue-reconcile commit on the combined branch.
